Oliver (Finance): Heads-up: proposing a short "safeguard" experiment so legacy customers keep current effective rates while we preview new per-token bands. Need owners for preview exports, metering tags, customer copy, and strict rollback gates.

Zoe (Billing): Sounds good. For visibility I'd like a dedicated CSV column `safeguard=true|false` and `pricing_path=legacy|per_token` so downstream tools can filter easily.

Matt (RevOps): I'll draft the customer-facing preview text. Suggest we label previews: "preview — no charges applied" and include an FAQ line about proration and opt-in. Also recommend 72h notice if we ever flip live. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Pri (Product): From the API side please add `pricing_state` and `safeguard_version` to /billing and /account endpoints so Console and SDKs can display exact behavior. Also request a small smoke dataset that emphasizes system prompts and multi-turn threads to catch token count shifts.

Sophie (Billing Ops): Metering plan: we'll tag test accounts with `acct.meta.pricing_safeguard=v1` and emit `safeguard:true` on staged aggregates. I'll gate via feature flag so QA can toggle without a deploy. Proration rule: annual plans remain on legacy pricing until renewal unless explicit opt-in. I'll add guard rails in the invoicer to enforce that.

Oliver (Finance): Proposed runbook:
```
- Create cohorts in staging (0.25% legacy-monthly, 0.25% legacy-annual, tiny pilot high-usage)
- Verify tagging on test tenant and smoke ingest
- Emit `safeguard` flag from metering (staging) for 14 days
- Generate invoice_preview CSV and include columns: account_id,billing_start,billing_end,plan,applied_rate,safeguard,pricing_path,invoice_preview_amount,tokens_billed
- Run csv diff vs baseline and token reconciliation script
- Canary: ramp 0.25% cohort for 48h, monitor invoice_preview_count, refunds_count, token_delta_pct, and any unexpected `pricing_path` flips
- Gating: abort if refunds_count > 2 OR token_delta_pct > 7% OR any invoices leave preview state accidentally
- Rollback: toggle off tags + re-run previews + auto-create support notices if any invoices were impacted
```

Zoe (Billing): I'll produce a sample CSV by EOD with the exact columns and run `csvdiff` against baseline. I'll also verify invoice preview rows are never sent to payment processors during the dry-run.

Matt (RevOps): Drafts incoming. I'll include an in-product banner with the copy: "Your billing preview: no changes unless you opt in" and a short FAQ about proration. Will link to a support article.

BillingBot: Ticket FIN-9012 created by Oliver (Finance): "safeguard pricing preview - runbook & canary". https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-9012

Pri (Product): Reminder: include the small eval simulating long system prompts and assistant/system role-heavy messages. In past rollouts this caught ~5% token divergence due to batching changes.

Sophie (Billing Ops): I'll add a reconcile job that compares staged per-account tokens to production baseline and alerts on >6% variance to `#billing-ops`. Also adding a check that preview invoices are flagged with `preview_only=true` so downstream exports ignore them.

Oliver (Finance): Great. Action owners: Zoe => CSV + csvdiff, Sophie => feature flag + emission + reconcile job, Matt => comms + banner, Pri => API PR and eval set. We'll meet tomorrow 11:00 to confirm gating thresholds and approve canary window. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
